# JustSkill Design

> Design, just a skill. An agent skill that takes a product idea from feature
> breakdown to approved screens to code: the agent writes one validated HTML
> file with inline CSS, the user reviews it on a local canvas, and the approved
> file becomes the spec the implementation is written against. No MCP server,
> no app, no account, no cloud.

## Install

```sh
npx skills add justskill-ai/justskill-design
```

Or ask the agent to install it:

```text
Install JustSkill Design for me by reading https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justskill-ai/justskill-design/main/llms.txt
```

DeepSeek Harness users can install the same code as a plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add justskill-design
```

## What it does

- Takes a product idea or a user-facing feature through a soft, skippable route:
  feature breakdown, confirmation, screens, implementation.
- Designs on a local canvas the user watches; the agent applies one change at a
  time and shows the receipt.
- Writes one self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and a `data-id` on every
  element, validated against a closed property set before the user sees it.
  Diagnostics name the fix instead of silently dropping a bad declaration.
- Leaves the validated file in the repository as the design artifact: it can be
  reviewed, diffed, committed and regenerated next to the code.
- Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent that supports the `skills`
  CLI, plus DeepSeek Harness.

## Use it

- "I want a note-taking app: record the small things worth remembering each day,
  and show my mood as a calendar heatmap." — start from a product idea.
- "Read this app's design and restyle it so the UI stops looking AI-generated."
  — restyle an existing product.
- "Design the settings page for this tool." — a single page.
- "Review this design and loosen the spacing." — adjust an existing design file.
